title: John catena: In the beginning was the Word (opening frag.)
english: From the catena fragments on John: the Gospel’s start — [[In the beginning was the Word >> Bible:John 1:1]] — is read so that the Word is not a creature among creatures but with God and God, the one through whom life and light come to those who receive him.

added_allusions.reason: In the beginning was the Word

translator_notes: Copy-text: First1KGreek / OpenGreekAndLatin Origen catena & scholia TEI (tlg2042.tlg006/017/077/078). PD.

title: John catena: witnesses and the Baptist’s voice
english: Further early fragments keep John’s witness in view: a voice in the wilderness preparing the way, not the Light himself but sent [[to bear witness about the Light >> Bible:John 1:7-8]].
